summary_markdown:
The conversation covered the current visibility adjustments and data consistency between staging and production environments. It was confirmed that inventory and VA (Visibility Adjustment) are currently copied from production, with future updates planned for location positions and roads.

A major discussion point was the need to separate testing environments: one dedicated for clients viewing approved data on Staging, and another for internal development/testing.

The consensus reached is to use the existing Dev Analytics environment for all new feature testing and model deployment. The current Staging environment will be reserved primarily for client data approval (client-facing view).
decisions: Staging environment will be used for client data approval.
Dev Analytics environment will be used for deploying models and testing new functionality.
action_items: Discuss the required client view on Staging with the client.
Finalize the internal development workflow (flow) in a separate discussion.
